description: Synergi Gas provides steady-state and transient hydraulic calculations for gas distribution, transmission and gathering networks. It represents pipes, valves, regulators, compressors and storage, and evaluates pressure, flow and gas composition. DNV documents hydrogen mixtures, thermal calculations and operational isolation analysis. The provider is DNV. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of operating conditions, network capacity and proposed equipment changes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network calculations. This is a thematic relation, not a claim of software interoperability.
